title: House of Sky and Breath
author: Sarah J. Maas
summary: The second Crescent City novel. In a modern city ruled by shape-shifters, angels and other beings, its heroine and her allies face new threats, with larger secrets about their world coming into view.
readIf: you want an urban fantasy romance that mixes mystery, quips and huge reveals.
skipIf: you have not read House of Earth and Blood, since the story builds directly on it.

pairings.reason: The first Crescent City book, which sets up the world and the pair at the centre.
Another sequel in which the romance and a huge world of politics deepen.
A smaller, snappier fantasy that also sets magical cities side by side.
